_doc: Benchmarks are always shortlisted. deny = discovered sites excluded by hand, shown greyed out with the stated reason. Keys are '<osm type>/<osm id>'.

benchmarks.name: St. Lorenzkirche plaza
benchmarks.note: OSM maps Lorenzer Platz only as pedestrian lines; the plaza is those lines buffered by bufferM, kept within clipM of the St. Lorenz church (way 144721691), minus LoD2 buildings

_focusDoc: The organisers' two relocation options are simulated; the current site is kept as the 'today' baseline. Discovered sites stay in candidates.json as context.
_overridesDoc: Graph edges that OSM cannot express. Each needs a source. openingHours uses the OSM opening_hours subset (e.g. 'Mo-Sa 09:30-20:00').

graphOverrides.name: Passage -> Galeria lift -> Königstraße (Lorenzkirche station)
graphOverrides.modelling: from = top of the station lift (platform <-> passage, OSM node 4330689591); to = Galeria's Königstraße door. OSM does not map the passage-to-Galeria link, and the passage ramp to Königstraße (node 312496655) is closed during the works
graphOverrides.source: VAG notice 27.01.2025 'Lorenzer Passage: Bauarbeiten gehen in die nächste Runde': the station lift only runs platform <-> passage; step-free street access only via the Galeria lift during Galeria opening hours (OSM node 792628472 opening_hours=Mo-Sa 09:30-20:00); renovation until end of 2027
